{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vena isolationists''' were a group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vena]] who opposed [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]]'s bid to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] to the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], took precautions to ensure that the Isolationists did not follow Omnino to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].

==History==
Descended from early [[Hapan]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], the [[Venan]]s had a tradition of maintaining an independent and isolationist stance on their system, remaining unaffiliated from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], even though they shared a good relationship and the Venans would occasionally trade with the nearby [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="btr">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020411crise&c=rpg|text=Before the Rise}}</ref>

Circa [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], the rise of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Kindoro]] and Baroness [[Omnino]] to power on Vena changed this historic position. Due to the fact that Kindoro and Omnino had been both [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], this contact with outsiders motivated an economic deregulation and active foreign policy, including trade agreements, in order to make goods accessible to the Venan royal family.<ref name="btr" />

This radical shift angered many Venans, who resented the fact that only the royal family was benefitting from the economic opening. The commoners called for a return to isolationism and the old-fashioned values. The regents, unwilling to give in to popular demands, imprisoned the movement leaders and sent them to labor camps. This move aggravated tensions and motivated the emergence of terrorism and sabotage against Venan nobility.<ref name="btr" />

This conflict was worsened with the death of Kindoro, as Baroness Omnino proved herself even more unmerciful than her husband, and waged [[Venan civil war|bloody war]] for years against her subjects,<ref name="btr" /> until her death in [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]].<ref name="Last3">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell 3|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell'' 3]]</ref>
